patches.name: Android Auto audio sync
patches.description: Holds video back so it lines up with the sound from the car over wireless Android Auto, which plays sound later than the phone expects. Works with apps whose video player uses Android's standard audio output (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit and most others). Change the delay later in the SoundSync app.

options.title: Delay (ms)
options.description: How far behind the car plays the sound. Used until you change it in the SoundSync app, or always if that app isn't installed.

options.title: When to apply
options.description: Used until you change it in the SoundSync app.
